proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  classical
  intro N inst c
  have hp (s : Finset (ZMod N)) : (M7.Supports.polynomial s).natDegree ≤ N := by
    by_cases hz : M7.Supports.polynomial s = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · have hm := Polynomial.natDegree_mem_support_of_nonzero hz
      rw [M7.Supports.support] at hm
      obtain ⟨i, hi, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      have hv := ZMod.val_lt i
      omega
  have hm : (M6.Cyclic.modulus N).natDegree ≤ N := by
    change (Polynomial.X ^ N + (1 : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial)).natDegree ≤ N
    calc
      _ ≤ max (Polynomial.X ^ N : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial).natDegree (1 : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ N := by simp
  have hc := M6.Euclid.preprocess_correct_cost N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (hp c.1) (hp c.2) hm
  simpa [M8.Solver.originalF, M8.PhysicalBridge.signature, M7.RecipeSignature.signature] using hc.1
